SCHEDULE OF RESIDUAL VALUE GUARANTIES SUBSTANTIALLY IDENTICAL IN ALL MATERIAL RESPECTS TO THE RESIDUAL VALUE GUARANTY FILED AS EXHIBIT 10.31 TO THIS REGISTRATION STATEMENT ON FORM S-1, PURSUANT TO INSTRUCTION 2 TO ITEM 601 OF REGULATION S-K
